# nemau_listener (Resource)

A listening port on a load balancer.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_listener" "https" {
  load_balancer_id    = nemau_load_balancer.edge.id
  name                = "https"
  protocol            = "TERMINATED_HTTPS"
  protocol_port       = 443
  default_pool_id     = nemau_pool.web.id
  tls_certificate_ref = nemau_load_balancer_certificate.www.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `load_balancer_id` (String) Id of the load balancer the listener belongs to.
- `name` (String) Listener name. Changes in place.
- `protocol` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTPS` (passed through), `TERMINATED_HTTPS` (decrypted on the load balancer, needs `tls_certificate_ref`), `TCP` or `UDP`.
- `protocol_port` (Number) Port the listener accepts connections on.

### Optional

- `admin_state_up` (Boolean) Administrative state, `true` by default; `false` takes the listener out of service. Changing it replaces the listener.
- `connection_limit` (Number) Maximum number of concurrent connections, 0 to 1000000. Not supported on `UDP` listeners. Changes in place.
- `default_pool_id` (String) Id of the pool that receives the traffic.
- `description` (String) Free-form description. Changes in place.
- `tls_certificate_ref` (String) ID of the `nemau_load_balancer_certificate` a `TERMINATED_HTTPS` listener serves; required for that protocol, refused for the others. Changes in place.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Listener id.
- `operating_status` (String) Operating status as reported by the platform.
